sidue; a054 no documented swabs; a055 neither. Those omissions are not measurements or contradictions. Wording varies meaningfully through title syntax, paragraph versus continuous prose, order of subject/basis/variables, description length and distribution-only versus description-plus-distribution documentation; much filler remains modular/template-like. Each record has CSV and JSON descriptions consistently associating its own variable set with comma-separated or JSON c

ontent; optional third distributions repeat the same variables and do not add measurements. Boolean distribution verification concerns those metadata associations only, not downloaded bytes.
